recipes.name: Crunchy squid threads
ingredients: ½ pound (226 grams) dried squid threads (ojingeo-silchae), cut into bite size pieces
instructions: Heat up a large pan over medium heat. Add the vegetable oil and garlic and stir fry until fragrant.
Add the squid threads and mix and stir with a wooden spoon and a pair of tongs for a few minutes, until the squid turns a little crunchy and shiny all over.
Add the soy sauce and sugar and keep mixing and stirring until the sugar is melted and the squid turns a little curly.
Remove from the heat and sprinkle with the sesame seeds.
Serve as a side dish for rice or with beer. You can keep it in the fridge for up to 1 month.
